items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It belonged to a guy named Percy Knight. He had borrowed it from Percy, and Percy had given me permission to play on it too.

ctx.x: It was awful, because he and I didn’t part on the greatest of terms at that particular time. He had pawned an instrument that I was using – he and I both were using. It belonged to a guy named Percy Knight. He had borrowed it from Percy, and Percy had given me permission to play on it too. So Bird and I were sharing this horn. Then he pawned it. He took it from me one night when I was getting in a cab. I was real high. I was getting in a cab, and he was saying, “Look man, you can’t go home with that like that.…
